dataList.content: Annette the Alterationist's Shield breaks когда she becomes Staggered. Try using Tremor Айдишки или Айдишки that hit multiple раз to break through Annette's Shield more efficiently.
Defending may be safer than attacking когда Annette uses her special Skill against an КакаятоХуйня.
Keep IQ under control to avoid entering Panic.
Make good use of allies that have Laurel Wreath of Atonement.
The Overseer consumes its own ХП whenever it summons a Tanned Prisoner.
Disobeying the Overseer's prohibitions causes it to retaliate with a powerful attack.
Distribute "Apocalyptic Vengeance" стаков across your allies вместо этого of letting them pile up on one unit. Used well, they can greatly reduce урона от certain Skills.
Winning a Clash against the Le Noir Brand Manager's "Covenant" Skill can greatly reduce the Shield it gains from "Revelation".

Если you are hit на the "Pick stitch too obvious, you say?! I'll pick-stitch your ass!" Skill while you have accumulated many стаков of Naildle, you will enter the "Taxidermized" state и receive devastating урона.
Если there are surviving Needlekins in the same turn as когда the King of Needleworks uses a powerful Skill, they will enhance that Skill's урона.

Sous Chef gains "Chopped Ingredients" from units she kills. These are consumed в конце хода, granting her стаков of "Eat yummies и Сглотнуть, you hear?".

The more she gets the стаков, the stronger и more frequent will her powerful move, "My signature knife work, you hear?", become.
Leather Wallets are not an exception когда it comes to Sous Chef's ingredient-gathering. You cannot stop her culinary activity на playing defensively.

Когда Sous Chef fails to kill any targets, she will get стаков of "Got an appetite, you hear?". При 3-х стакахх, she will use another powerful Skill. It may be a good idea to let her continue cooking every один раз in a while.
Sometimes, Clashing against the Floor Manager's certain skill with your Attack Skills could be a bad idea.

Be too wary и let yourself accumulate 10 стаков of "Guarded Caution", и you will risk inviting the Floor Manager's powerful Skill.
Pay attention so that "Guarded Caution" не reach 10 стака стака. You may also choose to теряет a Clash against a certain Skill to Убирает the.
Если you have "Gratitude for Listening", perhaps you will want to stay your attacks for a short while.

Higher стаков of "Tangling" increase урона taken и lowers Power. При 15+ стаков, certain Skills can force Stagger При ударе. Use Defense Skills или Clash against "Cleansing" to keep "Tangling" under control.
"Pool of Black Water" is lost only один раз за скилл при получении удара. Skills with high Вес атаки are the most efficient way to Убирает it in one go.

"Abyssal Maw," Blackthread of the Elden Sea's Skill, deals near-lethal урона если the target is Staggered или есть 20+ "Tangling". It can be Clashed against regardless of Speed, so keep "Tangling" стаков below 20 и always intercept it когда a Sinner is при risk.
Keeping Putty's Speed under control is key to this fight.
Manage счётчик Солей carefully so that Coins do not become Unbreakable.
